inputs.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 51.03 km effective diameter (catalog ±0.6 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. ATLAS2015–2018 photometry gives 368 orange and 127 cyan measurements, with period located by the ellipsoid search and a subsequently reconstructed convex shape. Both mirror poles remain; model 4787 is selected without claiming that mirror 4788 is false. No calibrated volume or resolved terrain is supplied. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.
